name: squat
description: One full bodyweight squat rep to just below parallel, retargeted from CMU mocap.

source.dataset: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database
source.clip: subject 86, trial 2 - 'walk, squats, run, stretch', 10618 frames @ 120 fps
source.licence: Free for all uses, including commercial products. Resale of the data itself (even converted) is not permitted.
source.acknowledgement: The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.

range.comment: second of three squats in the clip. Standing at 1373, bottom at ~1478 (hip drops to 54% of standing height - just below parallel), standing again by 1583. Subject 22's squats are ass-to-grass (36%) and read as a collapse on a stylised mannequin.

influence_comment: toes: kill mocap noise in a bone the mannequin barely has. legs at ~0.75: subject 86 squats well below parallel and the procedural shorts, a solidified band cut from the body, invert at that much hip flexion; damping the legs brings the rep to parallel where the garment survives. spine: subject 86 hip-hinges hard and folds the chest onto the thighs at the bottom. NEVER damp `root`: the heading correction that cancels the actor's yaw is baked into the root delta, so damping it turns the whole figure away from camera.
